# Slides

> Host for AI-made HTML/CSS/JS presentation decks. An Availabooks account is required to publish. Published decks are public.

Production: https://app.availabooks.com/slides

## Agent skill (includes CLI)

The skill folder is the whole package: markdown + a zero-dependency Node CLI.

- [slides skill](https://app.availabooks.com/slides/skills/slides/SKILL.md)
- [slides.mjs CLI](https://app.availabooks.com/slides/skills/slides/slides.mjs)
- [slides.zip](https://app.availabooks.com/slides/skills/slides.zip) — full skill folder (`SKILL.md`, `slides.mjs`, `package.json`)

Load the skill whenever you need to host or share HTML/CSS/JS slides (Reveal.js, impress.js, or hand-written decks).

Decks that use `#deck > .slide` (or `.deck > section`) automatically get mobile swipe, shareable `#n` links, and a thumbnail jumper. Reveal.js keeps its own `#/n` + overview. See the skill.

    curl -fsSL -o slides.zip https://app.availabooks.com/slides/skills/slides.zip
    unzip slides.zip
    node slides/slides.mjs login
    # finish sign-in in the browser, then:
    node slides/slides.mjs upload deck.html --slug my-talk

## Quick start

Prefer `slides login` (opens the system browser to Availabooks `/login`; no `--email` required). Optional headless Magic Auth: `slides login --email …` (never invent the 6-digit code).

Then upload with the CLI, or `POST https://app.availabooks.com/slides/api/upload` as multipart form data with a live session cookie (`availabooks-app-session` or `availabook-course-<id>`) and `Origin: https://app.availabooks.com`. Skip any `Set-Cookie` with `Max-Age=0`.

Pass `--host` / `SLIDES_HOST` for non-production. The share URL is on that same host — a local upload is not on app.availabooks.com.

Prefer the bundled CLI (`slides.mjs`). Never call WorkOS directly.

Success (201): `{ "id", "slug", "url" }`. Give the user `url` (example `https://app.availabooks.com/slides/d/<id>/`).

Modes: `paste` (field `html`), `files` (repeat field `files`, include `index.html`), `zip` (field `zip`). Max ~10MB.

Do not invent other publish APIs.
